description: Correlation field, confirmation_predicate, and freshness window for a processor-REST backend, per docs/spec/guarantee-model.md "confirmation_predicate per backend" table (commit 66fd62f), pattern drawn from giskard09/paypal-action-ref-anchor.
confirmation_predicate: idempotent GET on that id returns a terminal status value (e.g. COMPLETED) — not the response to the original write
freshness_window: bounded by the processor's own settlement SLA (typically seconds, not on-chain finality)

worked_example.provenance_disclaimer: SYNTHETIC — action_ref derived for a modeled pay_order call based on @paypal/agent-toolkit's public source (typescript/src/shared/{tools,parameters,functions}.ts). Not produced by a live PayPal sandbox call. No adoption or endorsement by PayPal is implied. Only the on-chain anchor of the action_ref is real; the capture id / GET confirmation described above is not exercised against a live PayPal endpoint.

expect.predicate_holds_for_worked_example: not applicable — no live capture id exists to test against; this vector documents the predicate shape only
